summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release about a letter of intent (LOI) with Nebo Holdings Limited for exclusive worldwide distribution rights to Nebo's Preempt OSINT darknet intelligence platform for data center operators. The LOI contemplates a 36-month license term with potential 24-month extension, one-off license fee and monthly support fees. The filing also notes an adjustment to the exercise price of certain warrants to $2.41428. This is a routine commercial agreement and warrant adjustment, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, financial terms, or structural mechanics beyond the agreement are disclosed. Watch for execution of the definitive agreement, but no risk-arb angle.
